regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your generous favors - fruits excellent - and checks, prayers, etc. I have been with this on my mind for weeks 21st Only late last nigh did I get to read your very interesting letter of the 16th. Thanks be to God! How wonderful was His delicate "hold- up" of that letter I had marked "Copy." ....! I sure congratulate you on seemingly providential guidance on your late trip But after all, what might we not expect if we would trust in God and leave things more and more in His divine hands. Simplicity and confidence in God was the real secret of Young Tobias' success in the Old Testiment - and Jacob's too. I will try and send the certificates - and write to Mrs. Goodwillie soon ..
